_targeting.anchor_role: Huawei Consumer Business Group, Portfolio Solution Presales (Apr 2026-Present). The only telco account on the CV, and the role that answers criterion 1 and criterion 2 directly. Given the most bullets (5) and the summary's opening claim.

bullets_used.bullet: Turned customer input into documented solution scope for a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator pursuit by covering the full requirements cycle across 3 technical workshops and a structured analysis session with the customer's engineering stakeholders.

De-risked what a Tier-1 UK operator pursuit could commit to by validating solution feasibility across 6 of the account's subnets before proposal, as dedicated presales cover inside a 5-person pursuit team.

Cut USD 2 of cost out of every unit for a Tier-1 UK mobile network operator by making the case across GTM roadmap and pricing reviews that a low-value feature carried no weight in the customer's buying decision.

Kept a Tier-1 UK operator's evaluation and demo unit programme on schedule by tracking 60 to 80 live sample units against launch deadlines, clearing cross-border transfers, and holding sign-off so product reached the customer's evaluation teams ahead of decision points.

Cut about an hour a week of sign-off paperwork and removed a daily manual check across every live sample by building VBA automation and a scheduled task into that programme, swapping hand-tracked deadlines for automated reminders and template-generated documents.

Delivered 100 percent of the HKMA's regulatory mandates inside a hard 14-day window by translating the regulation into an implementation plan and coordinating internal teams and third-party vendors to ship Geo-IP fraud detection with impossible-travel logic.
Recovered 8 hours a week of manual reporting effort across 20 systems, about 400 hours a year, by deploying a centralised Grafana observability framework in place of hand-assembled weekly reports.

Closed a 3-year backlog in e-banking incident triage by specifying and validating a Python anomaly-detection prototype, built with a developer, that separated critical incidents from deployment noise across 50,000+ historical logs.
Kept competing projects moving by arbitrating manday conflicts across priorities, either absorbing dependent work directly or building the business case for a timeline change.

Standardised requirements intake with a 7-question elicitation framework covering objective, context, stakeholders, success criteria, scope, constraints and evidence sources, closing gaps through follow-up interviews before anything reached JIRA.
Aligned third-party vendors and internal teams on a single integration path by running technical workshops that folded external fraud solutions into the bank's internal detection framework.
Reversed a headquarters decision by presenting evidence that store operations varied by location, moving the Shanghai development team off centralised training and onto store-specific delivery.
Won reporting-tool adoption from all 6 flagship store leaders by demoing it myself, walking each through their own use cases and daily upkeep before handing over ownership.

Eliminated roughly 1,500 manual hours a year across 6 flagship stores by replacing a 5-hour-per-store weekly data entry routine with a self-maintaining reporting setup, moving regional directors from lagging reports onto current labour data.

Generated GBP 350,000 in new B2B pipeline across a 50+ account portfolio by running discovery, solution positioning and qualification end to end, then escalating matured accounts to the corporate sales team to close.

Closed a GBP 50,000 deal with Hong Kong broadcaster Viu TV over 3 months, turning a walk-in store visit into a qualified opportunity, building credibility through hands-on technical support and a custom business pricing portal, then clearing their device-management objection by upselling MDM.
Onboarded 12 portfolio accounts onto custom stores with post-sales service coverage.
